jobs.title: SOC Operations Technical Lead
jobs.reason: This is a senior cybersecurity operations leadership role requiring 7+ years in Security Operations and deep technical expertise in SIEM/EDR/SOAR tooling — triggering hard ineligibility on the experience requirement. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch the candidate's IR research profile.

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Mismatch on all dimensions: this is an automotive quality-management auditing role requiring ISO 9001/IATF 16949 expertise, a chemistry degree, and 4+ years in automotive supply industry. The candidate also lacks the required Dutch language proficiency, triggering hard ineligibility.

jobs.title: Sales Manager for IS GC
jobs.reason: Pure B2B sales role in engineering/energy assurance — a complete mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy research profile. Hard ineligibility triggered: requires 10+ years sales experience and an engineering background, and the role is based in Shanghai requiring Mandarin client-facing capability the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Surveyor
jobs.reason: Pure mismatch — this is an industrial welding inspection/surveyor role requiring an engineering degree, IWE certification, and 2–5 years of experience in metal fabrication. None of the candidate's IR, policy, or research skills are applicable, and they lack the required technical engineering qualifications.

jobs.title: Freelance QHSE Auditor - Belgium
jobs.reason: This is a QHSE auditing role requiring a technical engineering degree, ISO 9001/14001/45001 expertise, 5+ years of industry experience, and business-fluent Dutch and French — all hard requirements the candidate does not meet. Multiple hard ineligibility triggers apply (5+ years experience requirement, Dutch fluency, specialist technical qualifications).

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor Food Netherlands
jobs.reason: This is a food safety auditing role requiring a degree in food technology, 5+ years of experience in quality management and food safety, and Dutch fluency (candidate has only A1). Multiple hard ineligibility triggers: specialist qualification the candidate lacks, 5-year experience requirement, and required working language not held.

jobs.title: Subcontractor Auditor Integrated Systems
jobs.reason: Mismatch on every dimension: this is a technical ISO management-systems auditor role requiring an engineering degree, 5+ years of industry experience, and business-fluent Polish — none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility triggered on both the Polish language requirement and the 5-year experience requirement.

jobs.title: Future Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: This is a quality assurance/HSE auditor role in automotive manufacturing — entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR, policy, and intelligence targets. The role also requires fluent Dutch (min B2), which the candidate does not have (A1 only), triggering hard ineligibility on language.

jobs.title: FSSC Auditor
jobs.reason: This is a food safety auditing role requiring GFSI auditor certification, a degree in food science/microbiology/chemistry, and at least five years of full-time food-industry experience — all hard requirements the candidate does not meet. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch.

jobs.title: Future Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Quality assurance / HSE auditing in automotive manufacturing is a complete mismatch with the candidate's IR and policy research background. Hard ineligibility also triggered: the role requires Dutch at B2 minimum, which the candidate only has at A1.

jobs.title: Director of Fundraising
jobs.reason: Director-level role requiring an extensive track record in income generation, six-figure deals, and senior team leadership — hard ineligibility on seniority. Although Chatham House is a core target institution, this is a fundraising/development position rather than a research role, and the candidate lacks the required fundraising expertise.

jobs.title: Research Associate - Air Power
jobs.reason: Field alignment is strong — air power, defence policy, and strategic studies at KCL's War Studies sit within the candidate's security studies interests. However, the role explicitly requires a PhD (awarded or near submission), which the candidate (MSc in progress) does not hold. Hard ineligibility triggered.
jobs.salary: £45,031 to £52,514 per annum (inclusive of London Weighting)

jobs.title: Research Associate, Global Health - Maternity cover
jobs.reason: Chatham House is a premier policy research institution and the Research Associate level fits the candidate's stage, but global health policy sits outside their core areas (IR, international law, security, atrocity prevention). The role specifically asks for research experience in global health policy or a related field, which the candidate lacks, though their research, writing, and stakeholder-engagement skills transfer.

jobs.title: CAMHRA Research Fellow
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility — the role is a Postdoctoral Research Fellowship explicitly requiring existing anthropological training at doctoral and/or postdoctoral level. The candidate is currently an MSc student without a PhD. The substantive focus (anthropology of mental health, ethnographic fieldwork) is also outside the candidate's core areas.

jobs.title: Finance Officer
jobs.reason: Finance/accounting role is outside the candidate's research/policy focus and likely requires accounting qualifications or experience the candidate lacks. The organisation's mission is highly relevant but the function is not.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.reason: This is a senior HR specialist role requiring substantial HR business partnering experience, employee relations casework leadership, and CIPD-level expertise — none of which the candidate has. Field, skills, and seniority are all clear mismatches for an MSc IR researcher.
jobs.type: Full-time or part-time, Fixed Term Contract (12 Months)

jobs.title: Research Officer – British Institute in Eastern Africa (BIEA) Partnership
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility — the role explicitly requires a PhD close to completion by the start date, which the candidate (currently MSc) does not have. It additionally requires fieldwork experience in Eastern Africa and a track record of academic publishing and grant funding that the candidate cannot match.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Group Finance
jobs.reason: This is a corporate finance role requiring accounting/finance expertise the candidate does not have. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch — the candidate's IR/policy research background is not relevant to group finance work.
